title: A modified protocol for rapid DNA isolation from cotton (Gossypium spp.)
author: Ali, Salisu, et al.

steps.title: Prepare extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Preheat extraction buffers A and B to 60 °C in a water bath. Add 400 µl of each buffer to a 1.5 ml nuclease‑free microfuge tube containing 100 mg seed flour. For leaf tissue, grind 100 mg tissue in 500 µl buffer A with a mortar and pestle, transfer to the tube, then add 400 µl buffer B.

substeps.instruction: Preheat buffers A and B to 60 °C.
Add 400 µl buffer A to tube with 100 mg seed flour (or ground leaf tissue).
If using leaf, grind 100 mg tissue in 500 µl buffer A, then transfer to tube.
Add 400 µl buffer B to the same tube.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture for 10 s, then incubate at 60 °C for 30 min in a water bath, inverting the tubes every 10 min to homogenize. (Use a TissueLyser for high‑throughput work to avoid cross‑contamination.)

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Cool tubes to room temperature, add RNase A to a final concentration of 25 µg ml⁻¹, invert 4–5 times, and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Add CIA and emulsify
steps.instruction: Pipette 400 µl of CIA into each tube and vortex for 5 s to form an emulsion.

steps.title: Phase separation by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 g for 10 min at room temperature to separate organic and aqueous phases. If the aqueous layer is not transparent, repeat this step.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Using a micropipette, carefully transfer the transparent aqueous layer to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 2/3 vol isopropanol and 1/10 vol 3.5 M NaAc (pH 5.2) to the aqueous phase, close the tube tightly, invert gently 5–6 times, and incubate at –20 °C for 15 min (or overnight to increase yield). Use wide‑bore tips to avoid mechanical damage.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 g for 5 min to pellet DNA, carefully remove the supernatant, add 400 µl chilled (–20 °C) 70 % (v/v) ethanol, and dislodge the pellet by flicking with a finger.

steps.title: Wash and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 13,000 g for 5 min, discard the ethanol supernatant, and dry the DNA pellet on a heat block without overdrying.

substeps.instruction: Dry pellet on heat block (do not overdry).

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried DNA pellet in 40 µl nuclease‑free water (or TE buffer if the DNA will be stored long‑term).
